current.text: Duren is back with Detroit after a contract holdout. He is projected to start at center next to Cunningham, Robinson, Thompson and Collins.
He has not played in the preseason yet.
His conditioning is a concern because he did not train hard during the holdout. Experts expect him to be eased in, with minutes stuck around 27 to 28 early and more minutes for Paul Reed.
Isaiah Stewart is gone, so Paul Reed is the only real backup center. In last season's NBA playoffs Reed outplayed Duren.
Tobias Harris is gone and Detroit lacks creators. Duren almost tripled his self-creation volume last season and was efficient on those plays.
His usage could rise to near 25 percent. If his minutes go above 28 and his usage rises, he could reach third round value.

Experts put his fair value around picks 40 to 50, which is round 3 to 4 in a 12 team league. ESPN's rank of 23 is too high, and one expert would never take him in round 2 or in the 20s. When he falls toward pick 50, experts see value.
His mock draft spot swings a lot, from about pick 30 to about pick 50, and it is moving back up (pick 35 in the latest mock). In an auction mock he went for 19 USD, close to the expected 20 USD.
Detroit is projected to win 50 to 51 games and finish third or fourth in the East.
Experts do not trust coach J.B. Bickerstaff's public comments on minutes. Last season Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation that limited everyone's minutes.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risk is expected.

durable.text: He is a strong pick and roll finisher who scores off the offensive glass and putbacks.
His FG% on high volume is a league outlier, so he lifts a team's FG% clearly.
His rebounding is a league outlier.
He makes no threes and does not space the floor.
He is an unusual big: he is not a big shot blocker and not a good defender.
He is a fairly solid free throw shooter for a center, so his FT% does not hurt much for his position.

note: Duren gives elite FG% on volume and elite rebounds, gives nothing in threes, and his FT% does not hurt much for a center, so he fits punt 3PM builds best. Experts see fair value around picks 40 to 50, which is about 20 USD in an auction. That is close to his Yahoo average cost of 20.6 USD and below ESPN's 24.7 USD, so do not chase him toward his Yahoo value of 28 USD or ESPN's 34 USD (he went for 14 USD in our league last season). Early in the season, check his conditioning and whether his minutes get above 28 or stay near 27 with Paul Reed taking extra time.
